remarks: Welcome to 512 North Street, a meticulous colonial nestled on 2.97 manicured and private acres, south of the Merritt Parkway. As you step into this distinguished home, you are greeted by an inviting formal living room adorned with a fireplace and french doors leading to a screened-in porch that offers tranquil views of the pool. Separating the living room and kitchen is a charming den with wet bar. The heart of this home features a recently remodeled kitchen. Adjacent to the kitchen is the dining room and also the family room, which features cathedral ceilings, built in's and a 2nd fireplace. Head upstairs and find 4 bedrooms with a primary suite that sports an ensuite bathroom, and walk-in closet. Lastly this home features a finished walkout basement and a 2 garage attached garage. Close to the Merritt Parkway, schools, Whole Foods, Greenwich Ave, and Westchester County Airport, with a short train ride to NYC.
